criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Part-Whole
categories.definition: One entity is a component, segment, or subset of the other entity.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: One entity is physically located, situated, or based within the other entity.

categories.name: Creator-Creation
categories.definition: One entity is the originator, author, designer, or producer of the other entity.

categories.name: Affiliation
categories.definition: One entity is a member, employee, representative, or affiliate of the other entity.

categories.name: Parent-Subsidiary
categories.definition: One entity owns, controls, or is a subsidiary of the other entity.

categories.name: Event-Participant
categories.definition: One entity participates in, competes at, or is associated with the other entity as an event.

categories.name: Product-Producer
categories.definition: One entity is a product, vehicle, or item manufactured or developed by the other entity.

categories.name: Geographic-Subdivision
categories.definition: One entity is a political or administrative division (e.g., city, state, country) belonging to the other.

categories.name: Spouse-Family
categories.definition: One entity is related to the other by blood, marriage, or kinship.

categories.name: Content-Platform
categories.definition: One entity is a creative work, channel, or program featured on or distributed by the other entity.

categories.name: Award-Nominee
categories.definition: One entity is an award or honor for which the other entity was nominated or won.

categories.name: Character-Creator
categories.definition: One entity is a fictional character appearing in or created for the other entity.

categories.name: Genre-Style
categories.definition: One entity is a genre, style, or category to which the other entity belongs.

categories.name: River-Waterbody
categories.definition: One river or waterbody flows into, is a tributary of, or connects with the other.

categories.name: Position-Role
categories.definition: One entity is a job title, role, or position held by the other entity.

categories.name: Instrument-Musician
categories.definition: One entity is a musical instrument played by or associated with the other entity.

categories.name: Architectural-Designer
categories.definition: One entity is a building or structure designed by the other entity.

categories.name: Sports-League
categories.definition: One entity is a sports team or club that competes within the other entity.

categories.name: Taxonomy
categories.definition: One entity is a biological taxon (e.g., family, order) to which the other entity belongs.

categories.name: Software-Platform
categories.definition: One entity is software or an application that runs on or is compatible with the other entity.

categories.name: Name-Origin
categories.definition: One entity is the namesake or etymological origin of the other entity.

categories.name: Award-Recipient
categories.definition: One entity is an award or honor received by the other entity.
